ok.title: I'm okay
ok.sub: Text messages often get through even when the internet is down.
ok.body: I'm okay and safe. I'll get in touch as soon as I can.

ok.hint: Opens your messages app. You press send.

where.sub: Read these coordinates to the {emergency} operator.
where.gpsHint: GPS works without internet. Outdoors, away from tall buildings, it finds you faster.

kit.title: Emergency kit
kit.reviewDue: It has been 6 months. Check expiry dates on water, food, medicines and batteries.
plan.title: Family plan
plan.useHere: Set to where I am now
plan.outOfAreaHint: Everyone updates this person. In a disaster, a long-distance call often gets through more easily than a local one.
plan.name: Name
share.title: Share plan
share.sub: Scan with another phone's camera. The plan goes into their Pharos without passing through any server.
share.tooBig: The plan is too big for a QR code. Send the link instead.
share.privacy: Anyone with this link can see the plan. Only send it to your family.
import.title: Import plan
import.sub: Someone shared a family plan with you.
import.bad: This link is broken or out of date.
trapped.volume: Turn the volume all the way up. The black screen saves battery.
sos.title: SOS light
sos.sub: Flashes the torch and the screen in SOS (··· ––– ···) so people can see you at night.
sos.warning: Warning: flashing light. Don't use it if you or someone near you has photosensitive epilepsy.
sos.screenOnly: The torch isn't available, only the screen will flash.
drill.title: Preparedness drill
drill.sub: 5 minutes with your family, twice a year. In the real moment you'll remember what you've practised.
drill.s1: Everyone says out loud where the two meeting points are
drill.s2: Everyone finds a safe spot in the room and does “Drop, Cover, Hold on”
drill.s3: Someone finds the emergency kit and checks expiry dates
drill.s4: Everyone knows how to switch off the mains electricity and the gas
drill.s5: Send a test “I'm okay” to your out-of-area contact
drill.due: It's been 6 months since your last drill
drill.first: You haven't done a drill yet
simple.title: Simple mode
simple.sub: Just two big buttons, for older people
simple.exit: Press and hold for normal mode
map.title: Offline maps
map.sub: Download your area's map. Then it works without internet.
map.failed: Download failed. Try again on Wi-Fi.
map.attribution: Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), via Protomaps.
map.openError: The map didn't open. Try downloading it again.
battery.title: Battery
battery.listSub: How much is left and how to make it last
battery.unsupported: This browser doesn't report the battery (e.g. iPhone). The tips always apply.
battery.measuring: Working out how long you have…
battery.tip1: Turn brightness down to the lowest you can read.
battery.tip2: Turn on “Battery saver” in your phone's settings.
battery.tip3: Turn off Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and mobile data when you don't need them. Texts and calls work without data.
battery.tip4: If there is no signal, use airplane mode and switch it off every few hours to check messages.
battery.tip5: Close apps you don't need, especially video, maps and games.
battery.lowTips: See how to make it last →
battery.devNote: Current (mA) is only available in the Android app and its accuracy varies by phone. Sampling every second also uses a little battery.
quakes.title: Earthquakes now
quakes.notOfficial: Information, not an official warning. Official warnings come from 112.
quakes.offline: This needs internet. Everything else in Pharos works without it.
quakes.error: Couldn't load. Try again in a moment.
quakes.none: No earthquakes above 2.5 in the last 48 hours.
quakes.credit: Data: EMSC (CC BY 4.0), with USGS as a fallback.
firstaid.title: First aid
firstaid.sub: What to do until the ambulance arrives. Works without internet.
firstaid.callFirst: Call 112 first, or ask someone to call, then follow the steps.
firstaid.sourceNote: Written in our own words from the EKAB (Greek National Centre for Emergency Care) handbook. Not a substitute for first aid training.
settings.title: Settings
nearby.title: Nearby
nearby.none: Nothing found near you on your map.
nearby.noAssembly: No assembly areas are mapped here. See the official map below (mySafetyPlan).
nearby.noData: To find places without internet, download your area's map first.
nearby.offlineLinks: These open only when you have internet.
nearby.credit: Places from OpenStreetMap (ODbL). Some may be missing or out of date — in an emergency call 112. Pharmacies and hospitals on duty are only on the official pages.
log.title: Incident log
log.sub: What happened and when. Show it to the ambulance crew.
cpr.sayStart: Push hard and fast in the centre of the chest, with the beat.
cpr.saySwap: Two minutes. Swap rescuers if you can.
cpr.afterCare: It's normal to feel shaken after something like this. Talk to someone you trust or to a doctor.
guardian.explain: If you tap the screen many times, fast and without purpose (for example from confusion or panic), Pharos asks “Are you okay?”. If you don't answer in 5 seconds it sounds a loud alarm with flashing light for 20 seconds, then opens a ready call to 112 and a text with your location.
guardian.limits: No phone lets an app call 112 by itself. The call opens ready and you, or someone nearby, presses call — so a false alarm can never become a real call. On most phones, calling 112 sends your location automatically (AML).
guardian.helpEn: Αυτό το άτομο ίσως χρειάζεται βοήθεια — καλέστε 112

setup.title: Set up your phone
setup.sub: 5 minutes now, so your phone can help when you can't use it.
setup.namesDiffer: Menu names differ a little between phone makers and versions. If you can't find something, search Settings for the word.
evac.title: Evacuate now
evac.leave: If you've been told to leave, leave. Nothing is worth more than your life.
phrases.title: Emergency phrases
phrases.sub: For people who don't speak Greek. Tap a phrase to show it large to someone.
ready.title: How ready are you?
ready.sub: Every step makes you readier before something happens.
